classification.material: all 10 pairs valid, primary 95% CI lower bound above 0, policy compliance passes, and wall-time 95% log-ratio CI upper bound below log(1.10)
classification.non_material: all 10 pairs valid and primary 95% CI upper bound is at or below 0

outcome_access_gate: authenticate all 20 terminal result artifacts and verify the complete-run gate before opening any result
primary: mean across pairs of OARS minus FIFO retained registered L1 coefficient opportunity per selected group over updates 1-64
secondary_quality: paired OARS minus FIFO terminal GSM8K accuracy with a two-sided 95% paired-t interval; not a success gate
training_dose: geometric mean OARS/FIFO ratio of valid actor tokens per update with a two-sided 95% paired-t interval on log ratios
wall_time: geometric mean OARS/FIFO ratio of seconds to update 64 with a two-sided 95% paired-t interval on log ratios
